name: text-highlight
title: Text Highlight
blurb: Highlight sweeps left to right behind inline text on mount, optionally fading…
description: Wraps text in a span with an animated linear-gradient background that expands from 0% to 100% width. Can optionally animate text color simultaneously with configurable delay and duration.
use_when: Call attention to key phrases in body text during page load, or sequential highlights across a sentence.
avoid_when: Repeated animations that loop; the effect runs once on mount and may feel jarring if retriggered.
a11y: Text is always readable and rendered in the DOM; animation cannot be paused with prefers-reduced-motion.
